== pipeline (exactly what ran - the repo's own script, unmodified) ==

                                        APKSIGNER_JAR=<apksigner 0.9>)

  inside the script:
  java -jar apktool.jar b <staged project> -o JVHD-unsigned.apk --use-aapt2
      -> classes.dex (838 classes) + classes2.dex (8 classes) + aapt2
         resource link with the bundled framework
  scripts/zipalign.py -f -p 4 JVHD-unsigned.apk JVHD.apk
      -> resources.arsc + lib/*.so STORED (apktool.yml doNotCompress),
         stored entries 4-aligned, *.so page (4096) aligned
  java -jar apksigner.jar sign --ks keystore/jvhd-debug.keystore
       --ks-pass pass:android --ks-key-alias jvhddebug --key-pass pass:android
  java -jar apksigner.jar verify --verbose --print-certs

== WebView software-rendering fix (the change vs the previous dist copy) ==
  MainActivity.smali onCreate: mWebView.setLayerType(View.LAYER_TYPE_SOFTWARE=1, null)
  -> WebView rendering goes through Skia software path; prevents the GPU
     driver crash (black screen) on MuMu Player and some Android TV boxes.
  Verified present in the shipped classes.dex (string pool contains
  setLayerType; Lcom/JVHD/vip/MainActivity; built from the checked-in smali).

== NOT verified (no physical Android device available) ==
  - real cold-start behaviour against https://jvhd-server.onrender.com
  - software-rendered WebView UI smoothness (software layer is slower on
    large viewports; correctness over speed on affected devices)
  - the renamed JNI export resolving on a real ART runtime (verified by the
    ELF hash simulation inside scripts/patch_btcore_jni.py, not by dlopen)
